CardDescription.DefaultText:
A manifestation of the Flintclaw spirit. 

Can help you perceive things in the dark, make you better at hiding, foraging and working flint,  give you courage and strength, make your weapons sharper and boost your immune system.
CardDescription.Text: 燧爪精魄的具现化。\n\n可以帮助你在黑暗中感知事物，使你更好地隐藏，觅食和使用燧石，给你勇气和力量，使您的武器更锋利并增强你的免疫系统。
CardDescription.zh: 燧爪精魄的具现化。\n\n可以帮助你在黑暗中感知事物，使你更好地隐藏，觅食和使用燧石，给你勇气和力量，使您的武器更锋利并增强你的免疫系统。
CardDescription.en: A manifestation of the Flintclaw spirit. \n\nCan help you perceive things in the dark, make you better at hiding, foraging and working flint,  give you courage and strength, make your weapons sharper and boost your immune system.
CardDescription.ja: フリントクローを擬人化したなにか。\n\n闇の中の認識能力、身を隠す能力、火打石の扱い方、勇気、筋力、武器の鋭さ、免疫力がブーストされる。
